Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne yahan par ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar warid kiya hai jo munkar hai, is mein hai ke ek shakhs Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke paas aaya, us waqt aap ke paas Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) bhi thay. Us ne in huroof ki tafsir aap se poochhi, aap ne zara si der sar neecha kar liya phir munh pher liya. Us shakhs ne dobara yahi sawal kiya to aap ne phir bhi munh pher liya aur us ke sawal ko bura jana. Us ne phir teesri martaba poochha, aap ne phir bhi koi jawab na diya. Is par Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne kaha: Main tujhe batata hoon aur mujhe yeh maloom hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ise kyun napasand kar rahe hain. Un ke ahl-e-bait mein se ek shakhs ke bare mein yeh nazil hui hai jise (Abdullah) aur Abdullah kaha jata hoga, woh mashriq ki nehron mein se ek nehar ke paas utray ga aur wahan do shehar basaye ga, nehar ko kaat kar dono shehron mein le jaye ga. Jab Allah Ta'ala un ke mulk ke zawal aur un ki daulat ka istisal ka irada kare ga aur un ka waqt khatam hone ka hoga to un dono shehron mein se ek par raat ke waqt aag aayegi jo use jala kar bhasam kar degi. Wahan ke log subh ko use dekh kar ta'ajjub karenge, aisa maloom hoga ke goya yahan kuch tha hi nahin. Subh hi subh wahan tamam bade bade sarkash mutakabbir mukhalif-e-haq log jama honge, usi waqt Allah Ta'ala un sab ko is shehar samet gharat kar de ga. Yahi ma'ani hain (Ha-Mim-Ain-Sin-Qaf) ke, yani Allah ki taraf se yeh azimat yani zaroori hai, yeh fitna qaza kiya hua yani faisal shuda hai Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se. Ain se murad adl, Sin se murad saikoon yani yeh anqareeb ho kar rahe ga, Qaf se murad waqay hone wala in dono shehron mein.

Is se bhi zyada ghurbat wali ek aur riwayat mein Musnad-e-Hafiz Abu Ya'la ki dusri jild mein Musnad-e-Ibn-e-Abbas mein hai jo marfoo' bhi hai lekin is ki sanad bilkul za'eef hai aur munqata' bhi hai. Is mein hai ke kisi ne in huroof ki tafsir Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suni hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) jaldi se ikathay hue aur farmaya: Haan, main ne suni hai. (Ha-Mim) Allah Ta'ala ke naamon mein se ek naam hai. Ain se murad (Ainal-mauloon azaba yaum-e-Badr) hai. Sin se murad (اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّانْتَــصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا ۭ وَسَـيَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَّنْقَلِبُوْنَ) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 227) hai. Qaf se kya murad hai ise aap na bata sakay to Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) kharay hue aur Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ki tafsir ke mutabiq tafsir ki aur farmaya: Qaf se murad (Qari'ah) aasmani hai jo tamam logon ko dhanp le ga. Tarjuma yeh hua ke Badr ke din peeth mod kar bhagne wale kuffar ne azab ka maza chakh liya. In zalimon ko anqareeb maloom ho jaye ga ke un ka kitna bura anjam hua?

In par aasmani azab aayega jo unhein tabah-o-barbad kar dega. Phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi! Jis tarah tum par is Quran ki wahi nazil hui hai, isi tarah tum se pehle ke paighambaron par kitabein aur saheefay nazil ho chuke hain. Yeh sab us Allah ki taraf se utray hain jo apna inteqam lene mein Ghalib aur Zabardast hai, jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein Hikmat wala hai. Hazrat Haris bin Hisham ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke aap par wahi kis tarah nazil hoti hai? Aap ne farmaya: Kabhi toh ghanti ki musalsal aawaz ki tarah jo mujh par bahut bhari padti hai, jab woh khatam hoti hai toh mujhe jo kuch kaha gaya woh sab yaad hota hai. Aur kabhi farishta insani surat mein mere paas aata hai, mujh se baatein kar jata hai, jo woh kehta hai main use yaad rakh leta hoon. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) farmati hain: Sakht jaaron ke ayyam mein bhi jab aap par wahi utarti thi toh shiddat-e-wahi se aap pani pani ho jate thay, yahan tak ke peshani se paseena ki boondein tapakne lagti thin. (Bukhari, Muslim). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se wahi ki kaifiyat poochhi toh aap ne farmaya: Main ek zanjeer ki si ghadghadahat sunta hoon, phir kaan laga leta hoon. Aisi wahi mein mujh par itni shiddat hoti hai ke har martaba mujhe apni rooh nikal jane ka guman hota hai. Sharh-e-Sahih Bukhari ke shuru mein hum kaifiyat-e-wahi par mufassal kalam kar chuke hain, falhamdulillah. Phir farmata hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq uski ghulam hai, uski malkiyat hai, uske dabao talay aur uske samne aajiz-o-majboor hai. Woh bulandiyon wala aur badaiyon wala hai, woh bahut bada aur bahut buland hai, woh unchai wala aur kibriyai wala hai. Uski azmat aur jalalat ka yeh haal hai ke qareeb hai aasman phat padein. Farishtay uski azmat se kapkapate hue uski paki aur tareef bayan karte rehte hain aur zameen walon ke liye maghfirat talab karte rehte hain, jaise aur jagah irshad hai: Ayat (Allazina yahmilunal arsha wa man haulahu yusabbihuna bihamdi rabbihim wa yu'minuna bihi wa yastaghfiruna lillazina amanu, rabbana wasi'ta kulla shai'in rahmataw wa ilma, faghfir lillazina tabu wattaba'u sabilaka wa qihim azabal jahim) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 7). Yani hamilan-e-arsh aur uske qurb-o-jawar ke farishtay apne Rab ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayan karte rehte hain, us par iman rakhte hain aur iman walon ke liye istighfar karte rehte hain ke ae hamare Rab! Tu ne apni rahmat-o-ilm se har cheez ko gher rakha hai, pas tu unhein bakhash de jinhon ne tauba ki hai aur tere raaste ke tabe hain, unhein azab-e-jahannam se bacha le. Phir farmaya jaan lo ke Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Phir farmata hai ke mushrikon ke a'maal ki dekh bhaal mein aap kar raha hoon, unhein khud hi pura pura badla doonga. Tera kaam sirf unhein aagah kar dena hai, tu kuch un par darogha nahin.

Hum ne kaha hamein to khabar nahin, aap farmaiye. Aap ne apne dahine hath ki kitab ki taraf ishara kar ke farmaya yeh Rabb-ul-Alameen ki kitab hai jis mein jannatiyon ke naam hain ma' un ke walid aur un ke qabeela ke naam ke aur akhir mein hisab kar ke mizan laga di gayi hai, ab in mein na ek badhe na ek ghate. Sahaba ne pucha phir hamein amal ki kya zaroorat? Jab ke sab likha ja chuka hai. Aap ne farmaya theek thak raho, bhalai ki nazdiki liye raho. Ahl-e-Jannat ka khatma nekiyon aur bhale a'amal par hi hoga go woh kaise hi a'amal karta ho aur naar ka khatma jahannami a'amal par hi hoga go woh kaise hi kamon ka murtakib raha ho.

Phir Aap ne apni dono mutthiyan band kar lein aur farmaya tumhara Rabb Azza-wa-Jal bandon ke faislon se faraghat hasil kar chuka hai, ek firqa jannat mein hai aur ek jahannam mein. Is ke sath hi Aap ne apne dayen bayen hathon se ishara kiya goya koi cheez phenk rahe hain. Yeh hadith Hasan Sahih Gharib hai. Yehi hadith aur kitabon mein bhi hai, kisi mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh tamam adl hi adl hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne jab Adam A.S ko paida kiya aur un ki tamam aulad in mein se nikali aur chiyuntiyon ki tarah woh maidan mein phail gayi to use apni dono mutthiyon mein le liya aur farmaya ek hissa nekon ka dusra badon ka. Phir unhein phaila diya, dobara unhein samet liya aur isi tarah apni mutthiyon mein le kar farmaya ek hissa Jannati aur dusra Jahannami. Yeh riwayat mauqoof hi theek hai, Wallahu A'lam. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Abdullah nami sahabi bimar thay hum log un ki bimar pursi ke liye gaye. Dekha ke woh ro rahe hain to kaha ke aap kyun rote hain? Aap se to Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farma diya hai ke apni moonchein kam rakha karo yahan tak ke mujh se milo. Is par sahabi ne farmaya yeh to theek hai lekin mujhe to yeh hadith rula rahi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai Allah Ta'ala ne apni dayen mutthi mein makhlooq li aur isi tarah dusre hath ki mutthi mein bhi aur farmaya yeh log is ke liye hain yani jannat ke liye aur yeh is ke liye hain yani jahannam ke liye aur mujhe kuch parwah nahin. Pas mujhe khabar nahin ke Allah ki kis mutthi mein main tha? Is tarah ki isbat-e-taqdeer ki aur bahut si hadithein hain. Phir farmata hai agar Allah ko manzoor hota to sab ko ek hi tariqe par kar deta yani ya to hidayat par ya gumrahi par, lekin Rabb ne in mein tafawat rakha, baaz ko haq ki hidayat ki aur baaz ko is se bhula diya, apni hikmat ko wohi janta hai, woh jise chahe apni rahmat tale khada kar le, zalimon ka himayati aur madadgar koi nahin. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai Allah Ta'ala se Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne arz ki ke ae mere Rabb! Tu ne apni makhlooq ko paida kiya phir in mein se kuch ko to jannat mein le jayega aur kuch auron ko jahannam mein. Kya hi achha hota ke sab hi jannat mein jate. Janab-e-Bari ne irshad farmaya Musa! Apna pairhan uncha karo, Aap ne uncha kiya, phir farmaya aur uncha karo, Aap ne aur uncha kiya, farmaya aur upar uthao, jawab diya ae Allah! Ab to sare jism se uncha kar liya siwaye us jagah ke jis ke upar se hatane mein khair nahin. Farmaya bas Musa! Isi tarah main bhi apni tamam makhlooq ko jannat mein dakhil karunga siwaye un ke jo bilkul hi khair se khali hain.

Aur bayan farmata hai ke saccha wali aur haqeeqi karsaz toh main hoon. Murdon ko jalana meri sifat hai, har cheez par qabu aur qudrat rakhna mera wasf hai, phir mere siwa aur ki ibadat kaisi? Phir farmata hai jis kisi amr mein tum mein ikhtilaf ronuma ho jaye us ka faisla Allah ki taraf le jao, yani tamam deeni aur dunyawi ikhtilaf ke faislay ki cheez Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasoolullah ko mano. Jaise farman-e-aali shan hai ayat: (Fa-in tanaza'tum fi shai-in farudduhu ilallahi war-rasooli in kuntum tu'minuna billahi wal-yaumil-akhir, zalika khairun wa ahsanu ta'wila) (Surah An-Nisa: 59). Agar tum mein koi jhagda ho toh usay Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki taraf lauta le jao. Phir farmata hai ke woh Allah jo har cheez par hakim hai wahi mera Rabb hai. Mera tawakkul usi par hai aur apne tamam kaam usi ki taraf sonpta hoon aur har waqt usi ki janib ruju karta hoon. Woh aasmanon-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyan ki kul makhlooq ka khaliq hai. Us ka ehsan dekho ke us ne tumhari hi jins aur tumhari hi shakal ke tumhare joray bana diye, yani mard-o-aurat aur chopayon ke bhi joray paida kiye jo aath hain. Woh isi paidaish mein tumhein paida karta hai, yani isi sifat par, yani jor-jor paida karta ja raha hai, naslein ki naslein phaila dein, qarnon guzar gaye aur silsila isi tarah chala aa raha hai, idhar insanon ka idhar janwaron ka. Baghawi (R.H) farmate hain murad reham mein paida karta hai, ba'az kehte hain pait mein, ba'az kehte hain isi tareeq par phailana hai. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain naslein phailani murad hai. Ba'az kehte hain yahan (fiha) ma'ani (biha) ke hai, yani mard aur aurat ke joray se nasl-e-insani ko woh phaila raha aur paida kar raha hai. Haq yeh hai ke khaliq ke sath koi aur nahin, woh fard-o-samad hai, woh be-nazeer hai, woh Samee-o-Baseer hai. Aasman-o-zameen ki kunjiyan usi ke hathon mein hain, Surah Zumar mein is ki tafseer guzar chuki hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke saaray aalam ka mutasarrif, malik, hakim wahi yakta la-shareek hai, jisay chahe kushada rozi de, jis par chahe tangi kar de, us ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahin. Kisi halat mein woh kisi par zulm karne wala nahin, us ka wasee ilm saari makhlooq ko gheray hue hai.

Yehi baat dusri ayat yani Ayat-ul-Kursi mein bhi hai. Un ki ek bhi na manna aur ala-al-ilan apne is aqeeday ki tableegh kar ke Allah ki nazil karda tamam kitabon par mera iman hai, mera yeh kaam nahin ke ek ko manun aur dusri se inkar karun, ek ko le lun aur dusri ko chhor dun. Main tum mein bhi wohi ahkam jari karna chahta hun jo Allah ki taraf se mere paas pahunchaye gaye hain aur jo sarasar adl aur yaksar insaf par mabni hain. Mabood-e-barhaq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai, hamara tumhara mabood-e-barhaq wohi hai aur wohi sab ka palanhar hai, go koi apni khushi se us ke samne na jhuke lekin darasal har shakhs balkay har cheez us ke aagay jhuki hui hai aur sajday mein padi hui hai. Hamare amal hamare sath, tumhari karni tumhein bharni. Hum tum mein koi talluq nahin, jaise aur ayat mein hai Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya hai agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein toh tu keh de ke mere liye mere aamal hain aur tumhare liye tumhare aamal hain. Tum mere aamal se bari aur main tumhare aamal se bezar. Hum tum mein koi khasumat aur jhagda nahin. Kisi behas mubahisay ki zaroorat nahin. Hazrat Suddi R.H farmate hain yeh hukm toh Makkah mein tha lekin Madinay mein Jihad ke ahkam utray. Mumkin hai aisa hi ho kyunke yeh ayat Makki hai aur Jihad ki ayatein hijrat ke baad ki hain. Qayamat ke din Allah hum sab ko jama karega jaise aur ayat mein hai (QUL YAJMA'U BAINANA RABBUNA SUMMA YAFTAHU BAINANA BIL-HAQQI, WA HUWAL-FATTAHUL-ALIM) (Surah Saba: 26), yani tu keh de ke hamein hamara Rab jama karega phir hum mein haq ke sath faislay karega aur wohi faislay karne wala aur ilm wala hai, phir farmata hai lautna Allah hi ki taraf hai.

Munkireen-e-Qayamat ke liye wa'idein: Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala un logon ko darata hai jo imandaron se fazool hujatein kiya karte hain, unhein rah-e-hidayat se behkana chahte hain aur Allah ke deen mein ikhtilaf paida karte hain. Unki hujat batil hai, un par Rabb ghazabnak hai aur unhein Qayamat ke roz sakht aur na-qabil-e-bardasht maar mari jayegi. Unki tama' puri honi yani musalmanon mein phir dobara jahiliyat ki khoo-boo aana muhal hai, theek isi tarah Yahood-o-Nasara ka bhi yeh jadoo nahin chalne dega. Namumkin hai ke musalman unke maujooda deen ko apne sache, ache, asal aur be-khare deen par tarjeeh dein aur us deen ko lein jismein jhoot mila hua hai jo muharraf-o-mubaddal hai. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala ne haq ke sath Kitab nazil farmayi aur adl-o-insaf utara. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai ayat (LAQAD ARSALNA RUSULANA BIL-BAYYINATI WA ANZALNA MA'AHUMUL-KITABA WAL-MIZANA LIYAQUMAN-NASU BIL-QIST) (Surah Al-Hadid: 25) yani humne apne rasoolon ko zahir daleelon ke sath bheja, Quran ke hamrah Kitab aur Mizan utara taake log insaf par qaim ho jayen. Ek aur ayat mein hai ayat (WAS-SAMA'A RAFA'AHA WA WADA'AL-MIZAN) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 7) yani aasman ko usi ne uncha kiya aur tarazuon ko usi ne rakha taake tum tolne mein kami-beshi na karo aur insaf ke sath wazan ko theek rakho aur tol ko mat ghatao. Phir farmata hai tu nahin jaan sakta ke Qayamat bilkul qareeb hai, ismein khauf aur lalach donon hi hain aur ismein duniya se be-raghbat karna bhi maqsood hai. Phir farmaya iske munkir to jaldi macha rahe hain ke Qayamat kyun nahin aati? Woh kehte hain ke agar sache ho to Qayamat qaim kardo kyunke unke nazdeek Qayamat hona muhal hai. Lekin unke bar-khilaf imandar is se kanp rahe hain kyunke unka aqeeda hai ke roz-e-jaza ka aana hatmi aur zaroori hai. Yeh is se dar kar woh a'maal baja la rahe hain jo unhein us roz kaam dein. Ek bilkul sahih hadith mein hai jo taqreeban tawatur ke darje ko pahunchi hui hai ke ek shakhs ne buland aawaz se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Qayamat kab hogi? Yeh waqia safar ka hai, woh Hazrat (ﷺ) se kuch door the, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Haan haan woh yaqeenan aane wali hai, to bata ke tu ne uske liye tayari kya kar rakhi hai? Usne kaha Allah aur uske Rasool ki mohabbat. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Tu unke sath hoga jinse tu mohabbat rakhta hai. Aur hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ka farman hai: Har shakhs uske sath hoga jis se woh mohabbat rakhta tha. Yeh hadith yaqeenan mutawatir hai. Al-gharaz Huzoor (ﷺ) ne is sawal ke jawab mein Qayamat ke waqt ka ta'ayyun nahin kiya balki sail ko us din ke liye tayari karne ko farmaya. Pas Qayamat ke aane ke waqt ka ilm Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin. Phir farmata hai ke Qayamat ke aane mein jo log jhagad rahe hain aur uske munkir hain, use muhal jante hain, woh nire jahil hain, sachi samajh sahih aql se door pade hue hain, seedhe raste se bhatak kar bahut door nikal gaye hain.

Un ki zillat-o-ruswai, darr-o-khauf aur in ki izzat-o-barai, aman-o-chain ka khayal kar lo, woh tarah tarah ki museebaton, takleefon mein honge, yeh tarah tarah ki rahaton aur lazzaton mein honge. Umda behtareen ghizayein, behtareen libas, makanat, behtareen biwiyan aur behtareen saaz-o-samaan unhein mile hue honge jin ka dekhna sunna to kahan? Kisi insaan ke zehen aur tasawwur mein bhi yeh cheezein nahin aa saktin. Hazrat Abu Taiba (R.H) farmate hain: "Jannatiyon ke saron par abr aayega aur unhein nida hogi ke batao kis cheez ki barish chahte ho? Pas jo log jis cheez ki barish chahenge wahi cheez un par is badal se barsegi, yahan tak ke kahenge hum par ubhre hue seene wali hum-umar auratein barsayi jayen, chunancha wahi barsein gi." Isi liye farmaya ke Fazl-e-Kabeer yani zabardast kamyabi, kaamil ne'mat yahi hai.

Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ) se qarabat-dari ki fazeelat. Upar ki aayaton mein jannat ki nematon ka zikr kar ke bayan farma raha hai ke imandar nek-kar bandon ko is ki basharat ho, phir apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke Quraish ke mushrikeen se keh do ke is tableegh par aur is tumhari khair-khwahi par main tum se kuch talab to nahin kar raha. Tumhari bhalai to ek taraf rahi, tum agar apni burai se hi tal jao aur mujhe Rabb ki risalat pohanchane do aur qarabat-dari ke rishte ko samne rakh kar meri eeza-rasani se hi ruk jao to yahi bohat hai. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se is aayat ki tafseer daryaft ki gayi to Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) ne kaha is se murad qarabat-e-Aal-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) hai. Yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya tum ne ujlat se kaam liya, suno Quraish ke jis qadar qabeelay thay sab ke sath Huzoor (ﷺ) ki rishtedari thi, to matlab yahi ke tum is rishtedari ka lihaz rakho jo mujh mein aur tum mein hai. Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ikrama, Hazrat Qatada, Hazrat Suddi, Hazrat Abu Malik, Hazrat Abdur Rahman waghera bhi is aayat ki yahi tafseer karte hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke main ne tumhein jo daleelein di hain, jis hidayat ka rasta bataya hai, is par koi ajr tum se nahin chahta siwaye is ke ke tum Allah ko chahne lago aur us ki itaat ki wajah se us se qurb aur nazdiki hasil kar lo. Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) se bhi yahi tafseer manqool hai, to yeh doosra qaul hua. Pehla qaul Huzoor (ﷺ) ka apni rishtedari ko yaad dilana, doosra qaul aap ki yeh talab ke log Allah ki nazdiki hasil kar lein, teesra qaul jo Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) ki riwayat se guzra ke tum meri qarabat ke sath ehsan aur neki karo. Abu Dailam ka bayan hai ke jab Hazrat Ali bin Hussain (R.A) ko qaid kar ke laya gaya aur Damishq ke bala-khanay mein rakha gaya to ek Shami ne kaha Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne tumhein qatl karaya aur tumhara naas kara diya aur fitna ki taraqqi ko rok diya. Yeh sun kar aap ne farmaya kya tu ne Quran bhi parha hai? Us ne kaha kyun nahin? Farmaya is mein (Ha-Meem) wali soortein bhi parhi hain? Us ne kaha wah sara Quran parh liya aur (Ha-Meem) wali soortein nahin parhin? Aap ne farmaya phir kya in mein is aayat ki tilawat tu ne nahin ki? Aayat (Qul la as'alukum alaihi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurba, wa man yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feeha husna, innallaha Ghafoorun Shakoor) (42. Ash-Shura: 23) yani main tum se koi ajr talab nahin karta magar mohabbat-e-qarabat ki. Us ne kaha phir kya tum woh ho? Aap ne farmaya haan! Hazrat Amr bin Shuaib (R.H) se jab is aayat ki tafseer pochi gayi to aap ne farmaya murad qarabat-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke Ansar ne apni khidmat-e-Islam ginwayin goya fakhr ke tor par. Is par Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ya Hazrat Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya hum tum se afzal hain. Jab yeh khabar Huzoor (ﷺ) ko mili to aap un ki majlis mein aaye aur farmaya: "Ansariyo! Kya tum zillat ki halat mein na thay? Phir Allah ne tumhein meri wajah se izzat bakhshi!" Unhon ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain.

Farmaya kya tum gumrah na thay? Phir Allah ne tumhein meri wajah se hidayat ki? Unhon ne kaha haan beshak aap ne sach farmaya phir aap ne farmaya ab tum mujhe kyun nahin kehte? Unhon ne kaha kya kahein? Farmaya kyun nahin kehte? Ke kya teri qoum ne tujhe nikal nahin diya tha? Us waqt hum ne tujhe panah di kya unhon ne tujhe jhutlaya na tha? Us waqt hum ne teri tasdeeq ki? Kya unhon ne tujhe past karna nahin chaha tha us waqt hum ne teri madad ki? Is tarah ki aap ne aur bhi bohat si baatein keen yahan tak ke Ansar apne ghutnon par jhuk pade aur unhon ne kaha Huzoor ﷺ hamari aulad aur jo kuch hamare paas hai sab Allah ka aur sab us ke Rasool ke liye hai. Phir yeh aayat (QUL LAA AS-ALUKUM 'ALAIHI AJRAN ILLAL MAWADDATA FIL QURBAA, WA MAY YAQTARIF HASANATAN NAZID LAHU FEEHAA HUSNAA, INNALLAHA GHAFOORUN SHAKOOR - 42. Ash-Shura: 23) nazil hui. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi isi ke qareeb za'eef sanad se marwi hai Bukhari-o-Muslim mein yeh hadith hai is mein hai ke yeh waqea Hunain ki ghanimat ki taqseem ke waqt pesh aaya tha aur is mein aayat ke utarne ka zikr bhi nahin aur is aayat ko Madine mein nazil shuda manne mein bhi qadre ta'ammul hai is liye ke yeh surat Makki hai phir jo waqea hadith mein mazkoor hai us waqea mein aur is aayat mein kuch aisi zyada zahir munasibat bhi nahin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke logon ne poocha is aayat se kaun log murad hain jin ki mohabbat rakhne ka hamein hukm-e-Bari hua hai aap ne farmaya Hazrat Fatima aur un ki aulad R.A. Lekin is ki sanad za'eef hai aur is ka rawi mubham hai jo ma'roof nahin phir is ka ustad ek Shia hai jo bilkul saqahat se gira hua hai is ka naam Hussain Ashghar hai is jaisi hadith bhala is ki riwayat se kaise maan li jaye gi? Phir Madine mein aayat nazil hona hi musta'ad hai haq yeh hai ke aayat Makki hai aur Makka Sharif mein Hazrat Fatima ka aqd hi na hua tha aulad kaisi? Aap ka aqd to sirf Hazrat Ali ke sath jang-e-Badr ke baad sanah 2 Hijri mein hua. Pas sahih tafseer is ki wahi hai jo Habr-ul-Ummah Tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ne ki hai jo bahawala Bukhari pehle guzar chuki. Hum Ahl-e-Bait ke sath khairkhwahi karne ke munkir nahin hain hum maante hain ke un ke sath ehsan-o-sulook aur un ka ikram-o-ehtram zaroori cheez hai roo-e-zameen par un se zyada paak aur saaf suthra gharana aur nahin hasb-o-nasab mein aur fakhr-o-mubahat mein bila shak yeh sab se a'ala hain. Bilkhusoos un mein se woh jo muttabi'-e-sunnat-e-Nabi hon jaise ke aslaaf ki raush thi yani Hazrat Abbas aur Aal-e-Abbas ki aur Hazrat Ali aur Aal-e-Ali ki R.A Ajma'een. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne khutbe mein farmaya hai main tum mein do cheezein chhore ja raha hoon Kitabullah aur meri 'itrat aur yeh dono juda na hon ge jab tak ke hauz par mere paas na aayen. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Abbad bin Abdul Malik ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se shikayat ki ke Quraishi jab aapas mein milte hain to bari khanda peshani se milte hain.

Lekin hum se is hansi khushi ke sath nahin milte. Yeh sun kar aap bahut ranjeeda hue aur farmane lage Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai kisi ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahin ho sakta jab tak ke woh Allah ke liye aur us ke Rasool ki wajah se tum se mohabbat na rakhe aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abbas ne kaha Quraishi baatein karte hote hain hamain dekh kar chup ho jate hain ise sun kar mare gusse ke aap ki peshani par bal pad gaye aur farmaya Wallah kisi musalman ke dil mein imaan jagazin nahin hoga jab tak ke woh tum se Allah ke liye aur meri qarabat-dari ki wajah se mohabbat na rakhe. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne farmaya logo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka lihaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Ahl-e-Bait mein rakho. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne Hazrat Ali se farmaya Allah ki qasam Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke qarabat-daron se sulook karna mujhe apne qarabat-daron ke sulook se bhi pyara hai. Hazrat Umar Farooq ne Hazrat Abbas se farmaya Wallah tumhara Islam lana mujhe apne walid Khattab ke Islam lane se bhi zyada achha laga is liye ke tumhara Islam Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Khattab ke Islam se zyada mehboob tha. Pas Islam ke in do chamakte sitaron ka musalmanon ke in dono sayyidon ka jo mamla Aal-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aqraba-e-Paighambar ke sath tha wahi izzat-o-mohabbat ka mamla musalmanon ko aap ke Ahl-e-Bait aur qarabat-daron se rakhna chahiye. Kyunke nabiyon aur rasoolon ke baad tamam duniya se afzal yahi dono buzurg khalifa-e-Rasool the pas musalmanon ko in ki pairwi kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Ahl-e-Bait aur kunbe qabile ke sath jis aqeedat se pesh aana chahiye. Allah Ta'ala in dono khalifa se Ahl-e-Bait se aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke kul sahaba se khush ho jaye aur sab ko apni raza-mandi mein le le Ameen. Sahih Muslim waghera mein hadith hai ke Yazeed bin Hayyan aur Haseen bin Maysara aur Umar bin Muslim Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ke paas gaye Hazrat Haseen ne kaha ae Hazrat aap ko to badi badi khair-o-barkat mil gayi aap ne Allah ke Nabi ko apni aankhon se dekha aap ne Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baatein apne kaanon se sunin aap ke sath jihad kiye aap ke sath namazein padhin haq to yeh hai ke badi badi fazilatein aap ne samet lin achha ab koi hadith hamain bhi bataiye.

Is par Hazrat Zaid R.A ne farmaya mere bhatije suno meri umar ab bari ho gayi, Huzoor ﷺ ki rihlat ko arsa guzar chuka, baaz cheezein zehan mein mehfooz nahin rahin, ab toh yahi rakho ke jo az-khud suna doon use maan liya karo warna mujhe takleef na do ke takalluf se bayan karna pare. Phir aap ne farmaya ke Makkah aur Madine ke darmiyan pani ki jagah ke paas jise Khum kaha jata tha kharay ho kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne hamein ek khutba sunaya, Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, wa'z-o-pand kiya, phir farmaya logo main ek insaan hoon, kya ajab ke abhi abhi mere paas qasid-e-Allah pahunch jaye aur main uski maan loon. Suno main tum mein do cheezein choray ja raha hoon, ek toh Kitabullah jis mein noor-o-hidayat hai, tum Allah ki kitab ko mazboot thaam lo aur usko mazbooti se thamay raho, pas iski bari raghbat dilayi aur bohat kuch takeed ki. Phir farmaya ae mere Ahl-e-Bait, main tumhein apne Ahl-e-Bait ke baray mein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon. Yeh sun kar Haseen ne Hazrat Zaid R.A se poocha ae Zaid! Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait kaun hain? Kya aap ki biwiyan Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil nahin? Farmaya beshak aap ki biwiyan woh hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai. Poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya Aal-e-Ali, Aal-e-Aqeel, Aal-e-Jafar, Aal-e-Abbas R.A. Poocha kya un sab par sadaqa haram hai? Farmaya haan! Tirmidhi Shareef mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya main tum mein aisi cheez choray ja raha hoon ke agar tum use mazboot thamay rahay toh behko ge nahin, ek dusri se zyada azmat wali hai Kitabullah jo Allah ki taraf se ek latkayi hui rassi hai jo aasman se zameen tak aayi hai aur dusri cheez meri itrat mere Ahl-e-Bait hain aur yeh dono juda na hongi yahan tak ke dono mere paas Hauz-e-Kausar par aayein. Pas dekh lo ke mere baad kis tarah in mein meri janasheni karte ho? Imam sahab farmate hain ke yeh hadith Hasan Ghareeb hai aur sirf Tirmidhi mein hai. Yeh riwayat hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A ki riwayat se Tirmidhi mein hai ke Arafay walay din Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apni oontni par sawar ho kar jise Qaswa kaha jata tha khutba diya jis mein farmaya logo main tum mein aisi cheez choray ja raha hoon ke agar tum use thamay rahay toh hargiz gumrah nahin ho ge, Kitabullah aur meri itrat Ahl-e-Bait. Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah ki naimaton ko madd-e-nazar rakh kar tum log Allah Ta'ala se mohabbat rakho aur Allah ki mohabbat ki wajah se mujh se mohabbat rakho aur meri mohabbat ki wajah se meri Ahl-e-Bait se mohabbat rakho. Yeh hadith aur oopar ki hadith Hasan Ghareeb hai. Is mazmoon ki aur ahadees hum ne aayat (اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 33) ki tafseer mein warid kar di hain, yahan un ke dohrane ki zaroorat nahin, Falhamdulillah.

Ek za'eef hadith Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaame hue farmaya: Logo! Jo mujhe jaante hain woh toh jaante hi hain, jo nahin pehchante woh ab pehchan kar lein ke mera naam Abu Zar hai. Suno! Maine Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke tum mein mere Ahl-e-Bait ki misaal misl-e-Nooh (A.S) ki kashti ke hai, is mein jo chala gaya usne najaat paali aur jo is mein dakhil na hua halak hua. Phir farmata hai jo nek amal kare hum uska sawab aur badha dete hain, jaise ek aur aayat mein farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ek zarre ke barabar zulm nahin karta, agar neki ho toh aur badha deta hai aur apne paas se ajr-e-azeem inayat farmata hai. Ba'az salaf ka qaul hai ke neki ka sawab uske baad neki hai aur burai ka badla uske baad burai hai. Phir farman hua ke Allah gunahon ko bakhshne wala hai aur nekiyon ki qadr-dani karne wala hai, unhein badha chadha kar deta hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh jahil kuffar jo kehte hain ke yeh Quran tu ne ghad liya hai aur Allah ke naam laga diya hai, aisa nahin. Agar aisa hota toh Allah tere dil par mohar laga deta aur tujhe kuch bhi yaad na rehta, jaise farman hai aayat (وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْاَقَاوِيْلِ 44 ؀ۙ) (69. Al-Haqqah: 44) agar yeh Rasool hamare zimme kuch baatein laga dete toh hum unka dahina haath pakad kar unke dil ki rag kaat daalte aur tum mein se koi unhein is saza se na bacha sakta. Ya'ni yeh agar hamare kalam mein kuch bhi ziyadati karte toh aisa inteqam lete ke duniya ki koi hasti ise na bacha sakti. Iske baad ka jumla aayat (وَيَمْحُ اللّٰهُ) al-kh, (يَخْتِمْ) par ma'toof nahin balkeh yeh mubtada hai aur mubtada hone ki wajah se marfoo' hai. Aayat (يَخْتِمْ) par atf nahin jo majzoom ho. Wao ka kitabat mein na aana yeh sirf Imam ke rasm-e-khat ki muwafiqat ki wajah se hai, jaise aayat (سَـنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ 18؀ۙ) (96. Al-Alaq: 18) mein wao likhne mein nahin aayi. Aur aayat (وَيَدْعُ الْاِنْسَان بالشَّرِّ دُعَاۗءَهٗ بالْخَيْرِ ۭ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ عَجُوْلًا 11؀) (17. Al-Isra: 11) mein wao nahin likhi gayi. Haan iske baad ke jumle aayat (اَنْ يُّحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۙ) (8. Al-Anfal: 7) ka atf aayat (وَيَمْــحُ اللّٰهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ ۭ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَات الصُّدُوْرِ 24؀) (42. Ash-Shura: 24) par hai, ya'ni Allah Ta'ala haq ko wazeh aur mubeen kar deta hai apne kalimaat se, ya'ni dalail bayan farma kar hujjat pesh kar ke. Woh khoob dana beena hai, dilon ke raaz, seenon ke bhed us par khule hue hain.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi isi ke qareeb za'eef sanad se marwi hai Bukhari-o-Muslim mein yeh hadith hai is mein hai ke yeh waqea Hunain ki ghanimat ki taqseem ke waqt pesh aaya tha aur is mein aayat ke utarne ka zikr bhi nahin aur is aayat ko Madine mein nazil shuda manne mein bhi qadre ta'ammul hai is liye ke yeh surat Makki hai phir jo waqea hadith mein mazkoor hai us waqea mein aur is aayat mein kuch aisi zyada zahir munasibat bhi nahin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke logon ne poocha is aayat se kaun log murad hain jin ki mohabbat rakhne ka hamein hukm-e-Bari hua hai aap ne farmaya Hazrat Fatima aur un ki aulad R.A. Lekin is ki sanad za'eef hai aur is ka rawi mubham hai jo ma'roof nahin phir is ka ustad ek Shia hai jo bilkul saqahat se gira hua hai is ka naam Hussain Ashghar hai is jaisi hadith bhala is ki riwayat se kaise maan li jaye gi? Phir Madine mein aayat nazil hona hi musta'ad hai haq yeh hai ke aayat Makki hai aur Makka Sharif mein Hazrat Fatima ka aqd hi na hua tha aulad kaisi? Aap ka aqd to sirf Hazrat Ali ke sath jang-e-Badr ke baad sanah 2 Hijri mein hua. Pas sahih tafseer is ki wahi hai jo Habr-ul-Ummah Tarjuman-ul-Quran Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A ne ki hai jo bahawala Bukhari pehle guzar chuki. Hum Ahl-e-Bait ke sath khairkhwahi karne ke munkir nahin hain hum maante hain ke un ke sath ehsan-o-sulook aur un ka ikram-o-ehtram zaroori cheez hai roo-e-zameen par un se zyada paak aur saaf suthra gharana aur nahin hasb-o-nasab mein aur fakhr-o-mubahat mein bila shak yeh sab se a'ala hain. Bilkhusoos un mein se woh jo muttabi'-e-sunnat-e-Nabi hon jaise ke aslaaf ki raush thi yani Hazrat Abbas aur Aal-e-Abbas ki aur Hazrat Ali aur Aal-e-Ali ki R.A Ajma'een. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apne khutbe mein farmaya hai main tum mein do cheezein chhore ja raha hoon Kitabullah aur meri 'itrat aur yeh dono juda na hon ge jab tak ke hauz par mere paas na aayen. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Abbad bin Abdul Malik ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se shikayat ki ke Quraishi jab aapas mein milte hain to bari khanda peshani se milte hain.

Lekin hum se is hansi khushi ke sath nahin milte. Yeh sun kar aap bahut ranjeeda hue aur farmane lage Allah ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri jaan hai kisi ke dil mein imaan dakhil nahin ho sakta jab tak ke woh Allah ke liye aur us ke Rasool ki wajah se tum se mohabbat na rakhe aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abbas ne kaha Quraishi baatein karte hote hain hamain dekh kar chup ho jate hain ise sun kar mare gusse ke aap ki peshani par bal pad gaye aur farmaya Wallah kisi musalman ke dil mein imaan jagazin nahin hoga jab tak ke woh tum se Allah ke liye aur meri qarabat-dari ki wajah se mohabbat na rakhe. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ne farmaya logo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka lihaz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Ahl-e-Bait mein rakho. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke aap ne Hazrat Ali se farmaya Allah ki qasam Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke qarabat-daron se sulook karna mujhe apne qarabat-daron ke sulook se bhi pyara hai. Hazrat Umar Farooq ne Hazrat Abbas se farmaya Wallah tumhara Islam lana mujhe apne walid Khattab ke Islam lane se bhi zyada achha laga is liye ke tumhara Islam Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Khattab ke Islam se zyada mehboob tha. Pas Islam ke in do chamakte sitaron ka musalmanon ke in dono sayyidon ka jo mamla Aal-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur aqraba-e-Paighambar ke sath tha wahi izzat-o-mohabbat ka mamla musalmanon ko aap ke Ahl-e-Bait aur qarabat-daron se rakhna chahiye. Kyunke nabiyon aur rasoolon ke baad tamam duniya se afzal yahi dono buzurg khalifa-e-Rasool the pas musalmanon ko in ki pairwi kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke Ahl-e-Bait aur kunbe qabile ke sath jis aqeedat se pesh aana chahiye. Allah Ta'ala in dono khalifa se Ahl-e-Bait se aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke kul sahaba se khush ho jaye aur sab ko apni raza-mandi mein le le Ameen. Sahih Muslim waghera mein hadith hai ke Yazeed bin Hayyan aur Haseen bin Maysara aur Umar bin Muslim Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam ke paas gaye Hazrat Haseen ne kaha ae Hazrat aap ko to badi badi khair-o-barkat mil gayi aap ne Allah ke Nabi ko apni aankhon se dekha aap ne Allah ke Paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki baatein apne kaanon se sunin aap ke sath jihad kiye aap ke sath namazein padhin haq to yeh hai ke badi badi fazilatein aap ne samet lin achha ab koi hadith hamain bhi bataiye.

Is par Hazrat Zaid R.A ne farmaya mere bhatije suno meri umar ab bari ho gayi, Huzoor ﷺ ki rihlat ko arsa guzar chuka, baaz cheezein zehan mein mehfooz nahin rahin, ab toh yahi rakho ke jo az-khud suna doon use maan liya karo warna mujhe takleef na do ke takalluf se bayan karna pare. Phir aap ne farmaya ke Makkah aur Madine ke darmiyan pani ki jagah ke paas jise Khum kaha jata tha kharay ho kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne hamein ek khutba sunaya, Allah ki hamd-o-sana ki, wa'z-o-pand kiya, phir farmaya logo main ek insaan hoon, kya ajab ke abhi abhi mere paas qasid-e-Allah pahunch jaye aur main uski maan loon. Suno main tum mein do cheezein choray ja raha hoon, ek toh Kitabullah jis mein noor-o-hidayat hai, tum Allah ki kitab ko mazboot thaam lo aur usko mazbooti se thamay raho, pas iski bari raghbat dilayi aur bohat kuch takeed ki. Phir farmaya ae mere Ahl-e-Bait, main tumhein apne Ahl-e-Bait ke baray mein Allah ko yaad dilata hoon. Yeh sun kar Haseen ne Hazrat Zaid R.A se poocha ae Zaid! Aap ke Ahl-e-Bait kaun hain? Kya aap ki biwiyan Ahl-e-Bait mein dakhil nahin? Farmaya beshak aap ki biwiyan woh hain jin par aap ke baad sadaqa haram hai. Poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya Aal-e-Ali, Aal-e-Aqeel, Aal-e-Jafar, Aal-e-Abbas R.A. Poocha kya un sab par sadaqa haram hai? Farmaya haan! Tirmidhi Shareef mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya main tum mein aisi cheez choray ja raha hoon ke agar tum use mazboot thamay rahay toh behko ge nahin, ek dusri se zyada azmat wali hai Kitabullah jo Allah ki taraf se ek latkayi hui rassi hai jo aasman se zameen tak aayi hai aur dusri cheez meri itrat mere Ahl-e-Bait hain aur yeh dono juda na hongi yahan tak ke dono mere paas Hauz-e-Kausar par aayein. Pas dekh lo ke mere baad kis tarah in mein meri janasheni karte ho? Imam sahab farmate hain ke yeh hadith Hasan Ghareeb hai aur sirf Tirmidhi mein hai. Yeh riwayat hai Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A ki riwayat se Tirmidhi mein hai ke Arafay walay din Rasool Allah ﷺ ne apni oontni par sawar ho kar jise Qaswa kaha jata tha khutba diya jis mein farmaya logo main tum mein aisi cheez choray ja raha hoon ke agar tum use thamay rahay toh hargiz gumrah nahin ho ge, Kitabullah aur meri itrat Ahl-e-Bait. Tirmidhi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah ki naimaton ko madd-e-nazar rakh kar tum log Allah Ta'ala se mohabbat rakho aur Allah ki mohabbat ki wajah se mujh se mohabbat rakho aur meri mohabbat ki wajah se meri Ahl-e-Bait se mohabbat rakho. Yeh hadith aur oopar ki hadith Hasan Ghareeb hai. Is mazmoon ki aur ahadees hum ne aayat (اِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًا) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 33) ki tafseer mein warid kar di hain, yahan un ke dohrane ki zaroorat nahin, Falhamdulillah.

Ek za'eef hadith Musnad-e-Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne Baitullah ke darwaze ka kunda thaame hue farmaya: Logo! Jo mujhe jaante hain woh toh jaante hi hain, jo nahin pehchante woh ab pehchan kar lein ke mera naam Abu Zar hai. Suno! Maine Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai ke tum mein mere Ahl-e-Bait ki misaal misl-e-Nooh (A.S) ki kashti ke hai, is mein jo chala gaya usne najaat paali aur jo is mein dakhil na hua halak hua. Phir farmata hai jo nek amal kare hum uska sawab aur badha dete hain, jaise ek aur aayat mein farmaya: Allah Ta'ala ek zarre ke barabar zulm nahin karta, agar neki ho toh aur badha deta hai aur apne paas se ajr-e-azeem inayat farmata hai. Ba'az salaf ka qaul hai ke neki ka sawab uske baad neki hai aur burai ka badla uske baad burai hai. Phir farman hua ke Allah gunahon ko bakhshne wala hai aur nekiyon ki qadr-dani karne wala hai, unhein badha chadha kar deta hai. Phir farmata hai ke yeh jahil kuffar jo kehte hain ke yeh Quran tu ne ghad liya hai aur Allah ke naam laga diya hai, aisa nahin. Agar aisa hota toh Allah tere dil par mohar laga deta aur tujhe kuch bhi yaad na rehta, jaise farman hai aayat (وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْاَقَاوِيْلِ 44 ؀ۙ) (69. Al-Haqqah: 44) agar yeh Rasool hamare zimme kuch baatein laga dete toh hum unka dahina haath pakad kar unke dil ki rag kaat daalte aur tum mein se koi unhein is saza se na bacha sakta. Ya'ni yeh agar hamare kalam mein kuch bhi ziyadati karte toh aisa inteqam lete ke duniya ki koi hasti ise na bacha sakti. Iske baad ka jumla aayat (وَيَمْحُ اللّٰهُ) al-kh, (يَخْتِمْ) par ma'toof nahin balkeh yeh mubtada hai aur mubtada hone ki wajah se marfoo' hai. Aayat (يَخْتِمْ) par atf nahin jo majzoom ho. Wao ka kitabat mein na aana yeh sirf Imam ke rasm-e-khat ki muwafiqat ki wajah se hai, jaise aayat (سَـنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ 18؀ۙ) (96. Al-Alaq: 18) mein wao likhne mein nahin aayi. Aur aayat (وَيَدْعُ الْاِنْسَان بالشَّرِّ دُعَاۗءَهٗ بالْخَيْرِ ۭ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ عَجُوْلًا 11؀) (17. Al-Isra: 11) mein wao nahin likhi gayi. Haan iske baad ke jumle aayat (اَنْ يُّحِقَّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۙ) (8. Al-Anfal: 7) ka atf aayat (وَيَمْــحُ اللّٰهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ ۭ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَات الصُّدُوْرِ 24؀) (42. Ash-Shura: 24) par hai, ya'ni Allah Ta'ala haq ko wazeh aur mubeen kar deta hai apne kalimaat se, ya'ni dalail bayan farma kar hujjat pesh kar ke. Woh khoob dana beena hai, dilon ke raaz, seenon ke bhed us par khule hue hain.

Tauba gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan aur apna karam bayan farmata hai ke woh apne ghulamon par is qadar meharban hai ke bad se bad gunahgar bhi jab apni bad kirdari se baaz aaye aur khuloos ke sath uske samne jhuke aur sache dil se tauba kare to woh apne rahm-o-karam se uski parda poshi karta hai, uske gunah maaf farma deta hai aur apna fazl uske shamil-e-haal kardeta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Wa man ya'mal su'an au yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafooran Raheema) (Surah An-Nisa: 110), jo shakhs bad-amali kare ya apni jaan par zulm kare phir Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish talab kare to woh Allah ko Ghafoor-o-Raheem payega. Sahih Muslim mein hai, Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba se us se zyada khush hota hai jis ki oontni jungle biyaban mein gum ho gayi ho jis par us ka khana peena bhi ho, yeh us ki justuju kar ke aajiz aakar kisi darakht tale par raha aur apni jaan se bhi hath dho baitha, oontni se bilkul mayus ho gaya ke yakayak woh dekhta hai ke oontni us ke paas hi khadi hai, yeh foran uth baithta hai, us ki nakeel tham leta hai aur is qadar khush hota hai ke be-tahasha us ki zaban se nikal jata hai ke Ya Allah beshak tu mera ghulam hai aur main tera Rabb hoon, woh apni khushi ki wajah se khata kar jata hai. Ek mukhtasar hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala apne bande ki tauba se is qadar khush hota hai ke itni khushi us shakhs ko bhi nahin hoti jo aisi jagah mein ho jahan pyas ke mare halak ho raha ho aur wahin us ki sawari ka janwar gum ho gaya ho jo use daf'atan mil jaye. Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A se jab yeh masla poocha gaya ke ek shakhs ek aurat se bura kaam karta hai phir us se nikah kar sakta hai? Aap ne farmaya nikah mein koi harj nahin, phir aap ne yahi aayat padhi, tauba to mustaqbil ke liye qabool hoti hai aur buraiyan guzishta maaf kar di jati hain, tumhare har qaul-o-fe'l aur amal ka use ilm hai. Bawajood is ke jhukne wale ki taraf mail hota hai aur tauba qabool farma leta hai, woh iman walon aur nek karon ki dua qabool farmata hai, woh khwah apne liye dua karein khwah dusron ke liye. Hazrat Mu'az R.A mulk-e-Sham mein khutba padhte hue apne mujahid sathiyon se farmate hain tum iman dar ho aur jannati ho aur mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke Roomi aur Farsi jinhein tum qaid kar laye ho kya ajab ke yeh bhi jannat mein pahunch jayen kyunke un mein se jab tumhara koi kaam kardeta hai to tum use kehte ho Allah tujh par rahm kare, tu ne bahut achha kaam kiya, Allah tujhe barkat de, tu ne bahut achha kiya waghera aur Quran ka wada hai ke Allah Ta'ala iman lane aur nek amal karne walon ki (dua) qabool farmata hai, phir aap ne isi aayat ka yeh jumla tilawat farmaya, ma'ni is ke yeh ke Allah un ki sunta hai jo baat ko maan lete hain aur us ki itteba karte hain aur jaise farmaya aayat (Innama yastajibulladhina yasma'oon) (Surah Al-An'am: 36).

(Al-An'am: 36) Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke apne fazl se ziyadati dena yeh hai ke un ke haq mein aise logon ki sifarish qabool farma le ga jin ke sath unhon ne kuch sulook kiya ho. Hazrat Ibrahim Nakh'i (R.H) ne is ayat ki tafsir mein farmaya hai woh apne bhaiyon ki sifarish karenge aur unhein ziyada fazl mile ga yani bhaiyon ke bhaiyon ki bhi shafa'at ki ijazat ho jaye gi. Mominon ki is izz-o-shan ko bayan farma kar kuffar ki badhali bayan farmayi ke unhein sakht dardnak aur ghabrahat wale azab honge. Phir farmaya agar in bandon ko un ki roziyon mein wus'at mil jati, un ki zaroorat se ziyada un ke palle par jata to yeh khurmasti mein aa kar duniya mein hullar macha dete aur duniya ke amn ko aag laga dete, ek dusre ko phoonk dena, bhoon khana. Sarkashi aur tughyan, takabbur aur be-parwahi had se barh jati. Isi liye Hazrat Qatada (R.H) ka falsafiyana maqoola hai ke zindagi ka saman utna hi achha hai jitne mein sarkashi aur la-ubali pan na aaye. Is mazmoon ki poori hadith ke "mujhe tum par sab se ziyada dar duniya ki numaish ka hai" pehle bayan ho chuki hai. Phir farmata hai woh ek andaze se roziyan pohancha raha hai, bande ki salahiyat ka use ilm hai. Ghina aur faqiri ke mustahiq ko woh khoob janta hai. Qudsi hadith sharif mein hai: "Mere bande aise bhi hain jin ki salahiyat maldari mein hi hai, agar main unhein faqir bana doon to woh deendari se bhi jate rahenge. Aur ba'az mere bande aise bhi hain ke un ke laiq faqiri hi hai, agar woh maal hasil kar lein aur tawangar ban jayen to is halat mein goya un ka deen fasid kar doon." Phir irshad hota hai ke log baran-e-rahmat ka intezar karte karte mayoos ho jate hain, aisi poori hajat aur sakht museebat ke waqt mein barish barsata hoon, un ki na-umeedi aur khushk-sali khatam ho jati hai aur aam taur par meri rahmat phail jati hai. Amir-ul-Momineen Khalifatul Muslimeen Farooq-e-Azam Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se ek shakhs kehta hai: "Amir-ul-Momineen! Qaht-sali ho gayi aur ab to log barish se bilkul mayoos ho gaye hain," to aap ne farmaya: "Jao ab Insha'Allah zaroor barish hogi," phir is ayat ki tilawat ki. Woh Wali-o-Hameed hai, yani makhlooqat ke tasarrufat isi ke qabze mein hain, us ke kaam qabil-e-sataish-o-tareef hain. Makhlooq ke bhale ko woh janta hai aur un ke nafa ka use ilm hai, us ke kaam nafa se khali nahin.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim hi mein hai ke jab Hazrat Imran bin Haseen (R.A) ke jism mein takleef hui aur log un ki ayadat ko gaye to Hazrat Hasan (R.H) ne kaha aap ki yeh halat to dekhi nahin jati hamain bara sadma ho raha hai, aap ne farmaya aisa na kaho jo tum dekh rahay ho yeh sab gunahon ka kaffara hai aur bhi bohat se gunah to Allah maaf farma chuka hai phir isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi hai. Abu al-Bilad kehtay hain ke main ne Hazrat Ala bin Badr (R.H) se kaha ke Quran mein to yeh aayat hai aur main abhi nabaligh bacha hoon aur andha ho gaya hoon, aap ne farmaya yeh teray maa baap ke gunahon ka badla hai. Hazrat Zahhak (R.H) farmatay hain ke Quran parh kar bhool janay wala yaqeenan apnay kisi gunah mein pakra gaya hai. Is ki aur koi wajah nahin, phir aap ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya batao to is se bari museebat aur kya hogi ke insaan yaad kar ke Kalam-e-Allah bhool jaye.

Aafat aur takaleef se khataon ki maafi hoti hai. Allah Ta'ala ki azmat, qudrat aur saltanat ka bayan ho raha hai ke aasman-o-zameen usi ka paida kiya hua hai aur in mein kayi sari makhlooq bhi usi ki paida ki hui hai. Farishtay, insaan, jinnaat aur mukhtalif qismon ke haiwanaat jo konay-konay mein phailay huay hain, Qayamat ke din woh un sab ko ek hi maidan mein jama karega. Jabke un ke hawas gum ho chukay honge aur un mein adl-o-insaf kiya jaye ga. Phir farmata hai, logo! Tumhein jo kuch museebatein pahunchti hain woh sab darasal tumharay apnay kiye gunahon ka badla hain aur abhi toh woh Ghafoor-o-Raheem Allah tumhari bohat si hukm-aduliyon se chashm-poshi farmata hai aur unhein maaf farma deta hai. Agar har ek gunah par pakray toh tum zameen par chal-phir bhi na sako. Sahih hadith mein hai ke momin ko jo takleef, sakhti, gham aur pareshani hoti hai us ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala us ki khataein maaf farmata hai, yahan tak ke ek kanta lagnay ke ewaz bhi. Aap ne usay sun kar khanay se hath hata liya aur kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Kya har burai-bhalai ka badla diya jaye ga? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Suno, tabiyat ke khilaf jo cheezein hoti hain yeh sab buraiyon ke badlay hain aur sari nekiyan Allah ke paas jama shuda hain. Hazrat Abu Idrees (R.H) farmatay hain, yahi mazmoon is aayat mein bayan hua. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmatay hain: Aao main tumhein Kitabullah Sharif ki afzal tareen aayat sunaun aur sath hi hadith bhi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne hamaray samnay yeh aayat tilawat ki aur mera naam le kar farmaya: Sun, main is ki tafseer bhi tujhay bata doon. Tujhay jo bimariyan, sakhtiyan aur balayein, aafat-ein duniya mein pahunchti hain woh sab badla hai tumharay apnay aamaal ka. Allah Ta'ala ka hukm is se bohat zyada hai ke phir inhi par aakhirat mein bhi saza karay aur aksar buraiyan maaf farma deta hai, toh us ke karam se yeh bilkul namumkin hai ke duniya mein maaf ki hui khataon par aakhirat mein pakray (Musnad Ahmad). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yahi riwayat Hazrat Ali (R.A) hi ke qaul se marwi hai. Is mein hai ke Abu Juhaifa jab Hazrat Ali (R.A) ke paas gaye toh aap ne farmaya: Main tumhein ek aisi hadith sunata hoon jisay yaad rakhna har momin ka farz hai, phir yeh tafseer aayat ki apni taraf se kar ke sunayi. Samundaron ki taskheer qudrat-e-Ilahi ki nishani. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apni qudrat ke nishan apni makhlooq ke samne rakhta hai ke usne samundaron ko musakhar kar rakha hai taake kashtiyan un mein barabar aayen jayen. Badi badi kashtiyan samundaron mein aisi hi maloom hoti hain jaise zameen mein oonche pahad. In kashtiyon ko idhar se udhar le jane wali hawayen uske qabze mein hain agar wohi chahe to in hawaon ko rok le phir to baadban bekar ho jayen aur kashti ruk kar khadi ho jaye. Har woh shakhs jo sakhtiyon mein sabr ka aur aasaniyon mein shukr ka aadi ho uske liye to badi ibrat ki ja hai, woh Rabb ki azeem-ush-shan qudrat aur uski be-payan saltanat ko in nishanon se samajh sakta hai aur jis tarah hawayen band kar ke kashtiyon ko khada kar lena aur rok lena uske bas mein hai isi tarah in pahadon jaisi kashtiyon ko dam bhar mein dubo dena bhi uske hath hai agar woh chahe to ahl-e-kashti ke gunahon ke ba'is unhein gharq kar de. Abhi to woh bahut se gunahon se darguzar farma leta hai aur agar sab gunahon par pakde to jo bhi kashti mein baithe seedha samundar mein doobe lekin uski be-payan rahmat unko is paar se us paar kar deti hai. Ulama-e-Tafsir ne yeh bhi farmaya hai ke agar woh chahe to isi hawa ko namuwafiq kar de. Tez-o-tund aandhi chala de jo kashti ko seedhi raah chalne hi na de idhar se udhar kar de sambhale na sambhal sake jahan jana hai us taraf ja hi na sake aur yunhi sargashta-o-hairan ho ho kar ahl-e-kashti tabah ho jayen. Al-gharaz agar band kar de to khade khade nakam rahein agar tez kar de to nakami. Lekin yeh uska lutf-o-karam hai ke khushgawar muwafiq hawayen chalata hai aur lambe lambe safar in kashtiyon ke zariye Bani Adam tay karta hai aur apne maqsad ko pa leta hai. Yehi haal pani ka hai ke agar bilkul na barsaye khushk-sali rahe duniya tabah ho jaye. Agar bahut hi barsa de to tar-sali koi cheez paida na hone de aur duniya halak ho jaye. Saath hi meenh ki kasrat tughyani ka, makanon ke girne ka aur poori barbadi ka sabab ban jaye yahan tak ke Rabb ki meherbani se jin shehron mein aur jin zameenon mein zyada barish ki zaroorat hai wahan kasrat se meenh barasta hai aur jahan kam ki zaroorat hai wahan kami se. Phir farmata hai ke hamari nishaniyon se jhagadne wale aise mauqon par to maan lete hain ke hamari qudrat se bahar nahin. Hum agar inteqam lena chahein hum agar azab karna chahein to woh chhoot nahin sakte sab hamari qudrat aur mashiyat tale hain (Fasubhanahu ma a'zama sha'nahu).

Darguzar karna badla lene se behtar hai. Allah Ta'ala ne duniya ki be-qadri aur iski haqarat bayan farmayi ke ise jama kar ke kisi ko is par utrana nahin chahiye kyunke yeh fani cheez hai. Balkeh aakhirat ki taraf raghbat karni chahiye, nek a'maal kar ke sawab jama karna chahiye jo sarmadi aur baqi cheez hai. Pas fani ko baqi par, kami ko ziyadati par tarjeeh dena aqalmandi nahin. Ab is sawab ke hasil karne ke tariqe bataye jate hain ke imaan mazboot ho taake dunyawi lazzaton ke tark par sabr ho sake, Allah par kamil bharosa ho taake sabr par uski imdad mile aur ahkam-e-Ilahi ki baja-awari aur nafarmaniyon se ijtinab aasaan ho jaye. Kabira gunahon aur fahash kamon se parhez chahiye. Is jumla ki tafsir Surah A'raf mein guzar chuki hai. Gusse par qabu chahiye ke ain gusse aur ghazab ki halat mein bhi khush-khulqi aur darguzar ki aadat na chhute. Chunancha sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne kabhi bhi apne nafs ka badla kisi se nahin liya, haan agar Allah ke ahkam ki be-izzati aur be-tauqiri hoti ho to aur baat hai. Aur hadith mein hai ke bahut hi ziyada gusse ki halat mein bhi aap (ﷺ) ki zaban se is ke siwa aur kuch alfaz na nikalte ke farmate: "Use kya ho gaya hai, uske hath khak-alood hon." Hazrat Ibrahim (R.H) farmate hain, musalman past-o-zaleel hota to pasand nahin karte the lekin ghalib aakar inteqam bhi nahin lete the balkeh darguzar kar jate aur maaf farma dete. Unki aur sifat yeh hai ke yeh Allah ka kaha karte hain, Rasool (ﷺ) ki itteba karte hain, jis ka woh hukm kare baja late hain, jis se woh roke ruk jate hain. Namaz ke paband hote hain jo sab se a'la ibadat hai. Bade bade umoor mein baghair aapas ki mushawarat ke hath nahin dalte. Khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko hukm-e-Allah hota hai, aayat (وَشَاوِرْھُمْ فِي الْاَمْر) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 159) yani un se mashwara kar liya karo. Isi liye Huzoor (ﷺ) ki aadat thi ke jihad waghera ke mauqa par logon se mashwara kar liya karte taake un ke jee khush ho jayen. Aur isi bina par Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne jab ke aap ko zakhmi kar diya gaya aur wafat ka waqt aa gaya, chhe aadmi muqarrar kar diye ke yeh apne mashware se mere baad kisi ko mera janasheen muqarrar karen. In chhe buzurgon ke naam yeh hain: Usman, Ali, Talha, Zubair, Sa'ad aur Abdur-Rahman bin Auf (Razi Allahu Anhum). Pas sab ne battefaq-e-raye Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko apna amir muqarrar kiya. Phir un ka, jin ke liye aakhirat ki tayyari aur wahan ke sawab hain, ek aur wasf bayan farmaya ke jahan yeh haq-e-Allah ada karte hain wahan logon ke huqooq ki adaigi mein bhi kami nahin karte. Apne maal mein mohtajon ka hissa bhi rakhte hain aur darja-ba-darja apni taqat ke mutabiq har ek ke sath sulook-o-ehsan karte rehte hain aur yeh aise zaleel, past aur be-zor nahin hote ke zalim ke zulm ki rok-tham na kar saken, balkeh itni quwwat apne andar rakhte hain ke zalimon se inteqam len aur mazloom ko us ke panje se nijat dilwayen, lekin haan! Apni sharafat ki wajah se ghalib aakar phir chhod dete hain.

Jaise ke Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne apne bhaiyon par qabu pa kar farma diya ke jao tumhein mein koi daant-dupat nahin karta balkay meri khwahish hai aur dua hai ke Allah bhi tumhein maaf farma de. Aur jaise ke Sardar-e-Anbiya Rasool-e-Allah Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ne Hudaibiya mein kiya jabke usi waqt kuffar ghaflat ka mauqa dhund kar chup-chap lashkar-e-Islam mein ghus aaye jab yeh pakad liye gaye aur giraftar ho kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kar diye gaye toh Aap ne un sab ko maafi de di aur chhod diya. Aur isi tarah Aap ne Ghauras bin Haris ko maaf farma diya yeh woh shakhs hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ke sotay huay us ne Aap ki talwar par qabza kar liya jab Aap jaagay aur usay daanta toh talwar us ke haath se chhoot gayi aur Aap ne talwar le li aur woh mujrim gardan jhukaye Aap ke samnay khada ho gaya Aap ne Sahaba ko bula kar yeh manzar dikhaya aur yeh qissa bhi sunaya phir usay maaf farma diya aur jaanay diya. Isi tarah Labeed bin A'sam ne jab Aap par jadoo kiya toh ilm-o-qudrat ke bawajood Aap ne us se darguzar farma liya aur isi tarah jis Yahudiya aurat ne Aap ko zehar diya tha Aap ne us se bhi badla na liya aur qabu panay aur maloom ho jaanay ke bawajood bhi Aap ne itnay baday waqiye ko jana-ana kar diya us aurat ka naam Zainab tha yeh Marhab Yahudi ki behen thi. Jo jang-e-Khaibar mein Hazrat Mahmood bin Salma ke hathon mara gaya tha. Ayesha (R.A) se main mohabbat rakhta hoon yeh to usi waqt wapas chali gayin. Aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) se sara waqia keh sunaya phir Hazrat Ali (R.A) aaye aur aap se batein keen. Yeh riwayat Ibn-e-Jarir mein isi tarah hai lekin is ke rawi apni riwayaton mein umooman munkar hadithein laya karte hain aur yeh riwayat bhi munkar hai. Nasai aur Ibn-e-Majah mein is tarah hai ke Hazrat Zainab (R.A) gusse mein bhari hui bila ittila Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke ghar chali aayin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ki nisbat kuch kaha phir Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se larne lageen lekin mai sahiba ne khamoshi ikhtiyar ki jab woh bahut keh chukin to aap ne Ayesha (R.A) se farmaya tu apna badla le le phir jo Siddiqa (R.A) ne jawab dene shuru kiye to Hazrat Zainab (R.A) ka thook khushk ho gaya. Koi jawab na de sakin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke chehre se woh sadma hat gaya. Hasil yeh hai ke mazloom zalim ko jawab de aur apna badla le le. Bazzar mein hai zalim ke liye jis ne bad-dua ki us ne badla le liya. Yehi hadith Tirmidhi mein hai lekin is ke ek rawi mein kuch kalam hai phir farmata hai haraj-o-gunah un par hai jo logon par zulm karein aur zameen mein bila wajah shar-o-fasad karein.

Chunancha Sahih Hadith mein hai, do bura kehne wale jo kuch kahein, sab ka bojh shuru karne wale par hai, jab ke mazloom badle ki had se aage na nikal jaye. Aise fasadi Qayamat ke din dardnak azab mein mubtala kiye jayenge. Hazrat Muhammad bin Wase R.H farmate hain, main Makkah jane laga to dekha ke khandaq par pul bana hua hai, main abhi wahin tha jo giraftar kar liya gaya aur Ameer-e-Basra Marwan bin Muhallab ke paas pahuncha diya gaya. Usne mujh se kaha, Abu Abdullah! Tum kya chahte ho? Main ne kaha, yahi ke agar tum se ho sake to Banu Adi ke bhai jaise ban jao. Poocha, woh kaun hai? Kaha, Ala bin Ziyad, ke apne ek dost ko ek martaba kisi seeghe par aamil banaya to unhon ne use likha ke hamd-o-salat ke baad agar tujh se ho sake to yeh karna ke teri kamar bojh se khali rahe, tera pet haram se bach jaye, tere hath musalmanon ke khoon-o-maal se aalooda na hon, to jab yeh karega to tujh par koi gunah ki rah baqi na rahegi. Yeh rah to un par hai jo logon par zulm karein aur be-wajah na-haq zameen mein fasad phailayein. Marwan ne kaha, Allah janta hai usne sach kaha aur khair-khwahi ki baat kahi. Acha ab kya aarzoo hai? Farmaya, yahi ke tum mujhe mere ghar pahuncha do. Marwan ne kaha, bahut acha. (Ibn Abi Hatim).

Pas zulm-o-ahl-e-zulm ki muzammat bayan kar ke badle ki ijazat de kar ab afzaliyat ki taraf raghbat dete hue farmata hai ke jo eeza bardasht kar le aur burai se darguzar kar le, usne badi bahaduri se kaam kiya jis par woh bade sawab aur poore badle ka mustahiq hai. Hazrat Fuzail bin Ayaz R.H ka farman hai ke jab tum se aakar koi shakhs kisi aur ki shikayat kare to use talqeen karo ke bhai maaf kar do, maafi mein hi behtari hai aur yahi parhezgari ka suboot hai. Agar woh na mane aur apne dil ki kamzori ka izhar kare to khair keh do ke jao badla le lo, lekin is soorat mein ke phir kahin tum badh na jao, warna hum to ab bhi yahi kahenge ke maaf kar do. Yeh darwaza bahut wus'at wala hai aur badle ki rah bahut tang hai. Suno, maaf kar dene wala to aaram se meethi neend so jata hai aur badle ki dhun wala din raat mutafakkir rehta hai aur tod-jod sochta hai.

Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ko bura bhala kehna shuru kiya. Huzoor ﷺ bhi wahin tashreef farma the, Aap ta'ajjub ke sath muskurane lage. Hazrat Siddiq R.A khamosh the, lekin jab ke usne bahut galiyan dein to Aap ne bhi ba'az ka jawab diya. Is par Huzoor ﷺ naraz ho kar wahan se chal diye. Hazrat Abu Bakr R.A se raha na gaya, Aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Woh mujhe bura bhala kehta raha to Aap baithe sunte rahe aur jab main ne us ki do ek baton ka jawab diya to Aap naraz ho kar uth ke chale? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, suno! Jab tak tum khamosh the, farishta tumhari taraf se jawab deta tha, jab tum aap bole to farishta hat gaya aur Shaitan beech mein aa gaya, phir bhala main Shaitan ki maujoodgi mein wahan kaise baitha rehta?

Phir farmaya suno Abu Bakr (R.A) teen cheezein bilkul haq hain: 001 Jis par koi zulm kiya jaye aur woh us se chashm-poshi kar le to zaroor Allah Ta'ala use izzat de ga aur us ki madad kare ga. 002 Jo shakhs sulook aur ehsan ka darwaza khole ga aur sila-rehmi ke irade se logon ko deta rahe ga Allah Ta'ala use barkat de ga aur ziyadati ata farmaye ga. 003 Aur jo shakhs maal barhane ke liye sawal ka darwaza khol le ga aur dusron se mangta phire ga Allah Ta'ala us ke yahan be-barkati kar de ga aur kami mein hi woh mubtala rahe ga. Yeh riwayat Abu Dawood mein bhi hai aur mazmoon ke aitbar se yeh bari pyari hadith hai.

Allah Ta'ala ko koi puchne wala nahin. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke woh jo chahta hai hota hai, use koi rok nahin sakta aur jo nahin chahta nahin hota aur na use koi kar sakta hai. Woh jise rah-e-rast dikha de use behka nahin sakta aur jis se woh rah-e-haq gum kar de use koi us rah ko dikha nahin sakta. Aur jagah farman hai, ayat (وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلْ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لَهٗ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا 17ۧ) (Surah Al-Kahf: 17), jise woh gumrah kar de uska koi chara-saz aur rehbar nahin. Phir farmata hai yeh mushrikeen Qayamat ke azab ko dekh kar dobara duniya mein aane ki tamanna karenge, jaise aur jagah hai, ayat (وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذْ وُقِفُوْا عَلَي النَّارِ فَقَالُوْا يٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ 27؀) (Surah Al-An'am: 27), kash ke tu inhe dekhta jab ke yeh dozakh ke paas khade kiye jayenge aur kahenge haye kya achi baat ho ke hum dobara wapas bhej diye jayen to hum hargiz apne Rab ki ayaton ko jhoot na batayen balkay iman le ayen. Sach to yeh hai ke yeh log jis cheez ko is se pehle posheeda kiye hue thay woh inke samne aa gayi. Baat yeh hai ke agar yeh dobara bhej bhi diye jayen tab bhi wahi karenge jis se mana kiye jate hain, yaqeenan yeh jhoote hain. Phir farmaya yeh Jahannam ke paas laye jayenge aur Allah ki nafarmaniyon ki wajah se in par zillat baras rahi hogi, aajizi se jhuke hue honge aur nazrein bacha kar Jahannam ko tak rahe honge. Khauf zada aur hawas bakhta ho rahe honge lekin jis se dar rahe hain us se bach na sakenge, na sirf itna hi balkay inke wehm-o-guman se bhi zyada azab inhe hoga. Allah hamein mehfooz rakhe. Us waqt imandar log kahenge ke haqeeqi nuqsan yafta woh log hain jinhone apne sath apne walon ko bhi Jahannam wasil kiya, yahan ki aaj ki abadi nematon se mehroom rahe aur inhe bhi mehroom rakha. Aaj woh sab alag alag azab mein mubtala hain, daimi, abadi aur sarmadi sazayein bhugat rahe hain aur yeh na-umeed ho jayenge. Aaj koi aisa nahin jo in azabon se chuda sake ya takhfeef kara sake, in gumrahon ko khalasi dene wala koi nahin.

Aasani mein shukr, tangi mein sabr mominon ki sifat hai. Chunke oopar yeh zikr tha ke Qayamat ke din bade haibat-naak waqiyat honge, woh sakht museebat ka din hoga, toh ab yahan is se dara raha hai aur us din ke liye tayyar rehne ko farmata hai ke is achanak aa jaane waale din se pehle hi pehle Allah ke farman par poori tarah amal kar lo. Jab woh din aa jaaye toh tumhein na toh koi jaaye-panah milegi, na aisi jagah ke wahan anjaan ban kar aise chup jaao ke pehchane na jaao aur na nazar pade. Phir farmata hai ke agar yeh mushrik na maanein toh aap in par nigahban bana kar nahin bheje gaye, inhe hidayat par laa khada kar dena aap ke zimme nahin, yeh kaam Allah ka hai. Aap par sirf tableegh hai, hisab hum khud le lenge. Insaan ki halat yeh hai ke rahat mein badmast ban jaata hai aur takleef mein nashukra-pan karta hai, us waqt agli ne'maton ka bhi munkir ban jaata hai. Hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aurton se farmaya, "Sadqa karo, main ne tumhein zyada tadaad mein Jahannam mein dekha hai." Kisi aurat ne poocha, "Yeh kis wajah se?" Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Tumhari shikayat ki zyadati aur apne khawandon ki nashukri ki wajah se. Agar toh in mein se koi tumhare saath ek zamane tak ehsan karta rahe, phir ek din chhod de toh tum keh dogi ke main ne toh tujh se kabhi koi rahat paayi hi nahin." Fi-l-waqia aksar aurton ka yahi haal hai, lekin jis par Allah raham kare aur neki ki taufeeq de de, aur haqeeqi imaan naseeb farmaye, phir toh us ka yeh haal hota hai ke har rahat pe shukr, har ranj par sabr, pas har haal mein neki hasil hoti hai aur yeh wasf bajuz momin ke kisi aur mein nahin hota.

Aulad ka ikhtiyar Allah ke paas hai. Farmata hai ke khaliq, malik aur mutasarrif zameen-o-aasman ka sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Woh jo chahta hai hota hai, jo nahin chahta nahin hota. Jise chahe de, jise chahe na de, jo chahe paida kare aur banaye. Jise chahe sirf ladkiyan de jaise Hazrat Lut Alaihis Salam. Aur jise chahe sirf ladke hi ata farmata hai jaise Ibrahim Khalil Alaihis Salam. Aur jise chahe ladke ladkiyan sab kuch deta hai jaise Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) aur jise chahe la-walad rakhta hai jaise Hazrat Yahya aur Hazrat Isa (A.S). Pas yeh chaar qismein huin; ladkiyon wale, ladkon wale, dono wale aur dono se khali hath. Woh Aleem hai, har mustahiq ko janta hai. Qadir hai, jis tarah chahe tafawat rakhta hai. Pas yeh maqam bhi misl us farman-e-Ilahi ke hai jo Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke bare mein hai ke taake hum use logon ke liye nishan banayein yani daleel-e-qudrat banayein aur dikha dein ke hum ne makhlooq ko chaar taur par paida kiya. Hazrat Adam (A.S) sirf mitti se paida hue, na maa na baap. Hazrat Hawa (R.A) sirf mard se paida huin. Baqi kul insaan mard aurat dono se, siwaye Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke ke woh sirf aurat se baghair mard ke paida kiye gaye. Pas aap (A.S) ki paidaish se yeh charon qismein ho gayin. Pas yeh maqam maa baap ke bare mein tha aur woh maqam aulad ke bare mein, us ki bhi chaar qismein aur is ki bhi chaar qismein. SubhanAllah, yeh hai us Allah ke ilm-o-qudrat ki nishani.

Quran-e-Hakim shifa hai. Maqamat-o-maratib-o-kaifiyat-e-wahi ka bayan ho raha hai ke kabhi toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dil mein wahi daal di jati hai jis ke wahi-e-Allah hone mein aapko koi shak nahin rehta, jaise Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban ki hadith mein hai ke Rooh-ul-Qudus ne mere dil mein yeh baat phonki hai ke koi shakhs bhi jab tak apni rozi aur apna waqt poora na kar le hargiz nahin marta, pas Allah se daro aur rozi ki talab mein achhai ikhtiyar karo. Ya parde ki oat se jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se kalam hua. Kyunke unhon ne kalam sun kar jamal dekhna chaha lekin woh parde mein tha. Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) se farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne kisi se kalam nahin kiya magar parde ke peeche se, lekin tere baap se apne samne kalam kiya. Yeh Jannat-e-Uhud mein kuffar ke hathon shaheed kiye gaye thay, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh kalam-e-alam-e-barzakh ka hai aur ayat mein jis kalam ka zikr hai us se murad duniya ka kalam hai. Ya apne qasid ko bhej kar apni baat us tak pahunchaye jaise Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) waghera farishtay Anbiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) ke paas aate rahe. Woh ulu aur bulandi aur buzurgi wala hai, sath hi Hakim aur hikmat wala hai. Rooh se murad Quran hai. Farmata hai is Quran ko bazariya-e-wahi ke hum ne teri taraf utara hai. Kitab aur iman ko jis tafseel ke sath bayan kiya hum ne apni kitab mein hai, toh is se pehle tu janta bhi na tha lekin hum ne is Quran ko noor banaya hai taake is ke zariye se hum apne imandar bandon ko rah-e-rast dikhlayein, jaise ayat mein hai (Qul huwa lilladhina amanu hudan wa shifa'un) (Surah Fussilat: 44) keh de ke yeh iman walon ke waste hidayat-o-shifa hai aur be-imanon ke kaan behre aur aankhein andhi hain. Phir farmaya ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum sareeh aur mazboot haq ki rehnumai kar rahe ho. Phir Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tashreeh ki aur farmaya ise shar'a muqarrar karne wala khud Allah hai jis ki shaan yeh hai ke asmanon zameenon ka malik aur Rabb wahi hai, in mein tasarruf karne wala aur hukm chalane wala bhi wahi hai, koi us ke kisi hukm ko taal nahin sakta. Tamam umoor us ki taraf phere jate hain, wahi sab kamon ke faisle karta hai aur hukm karta hai. Woh paak aur bartar hai har us cheez se jo us ki nisbat zalim aur munkireen kehte hain, woh bulandiyon aur badaiyon wala hai.
